🔮 AstroTrader Pro™ — Today’s sky — September 10, 2026

Sun, in Virgo, holds a sextile to Mars, in its fall in Cancer. Two tempers that rarely agree, briefly aligned: the worth of a thing and the account of it briefly coincide.

Easier — Reviewing, sorting, naming what a thing is worth to you.
Harder — Mistaking an easy day for a free one.
Backdrop — Jupiter and Saturn hold a month-long trine underneath all of it.

♈ ARIES
Mars, your ruler, is at its lowest in Cancer: effort costs double. Mars squares you from Cancer, and the cost objects. Cardinal fire meets a bill. Mercury let go of it a week ago.

♉ TAURUS
Venus rules you, exiled in Scorpio. Sun trines you from Virgo, meeting no resistance. Fixed earth keeps what it has, and keeping is easy. Since Venus crossed out of Libra, the question has changed.

♊ GEMINI
Mercury, your ruler, is at home and exalted in Virgo. Sun squares you from Virgo, and something has to give way. Air bends, and each bend is invoiced. Four weeks of Leo ended, and nothing carried over.

♋ CANCER
Moon rules you from Virgo, where nothing is owed to it. Sun sextiles you from Virgo: a door left ajar. Cardinal water opens the account without argument. The hold Pluto had a week ago is not there any more.

♌ LEO
Sun governs you, untitled in Virgo. Venus in Scorpio presses on you, and the pressure is arithmetic. Fixed fire: the grip is the expense. Four weeks ago Sun was still in Leo: the ground has moved.

♍ VIRGO
Mercury governs you from Virgo, where it lacks nothing. Mars in Cancer opens a gap you have to step into. Earth that changes shape, and the shape fits. The sextile of a week ago is off it now.

♎ LIBRA
Venus rules you from Scorpio, where none of its habits work. Mars squares you from Cancer: wanting and cost refuse to agree. Cardinal air starts and is invoiced for it. What pressed two weeks ago has cleared.

♏ SCORPIO
Mars rules you and is weak in Cancer: the grip tightens too soon. From Virgo, Sun hands you an opening. Water that holds on, holding without strain. 18° in a month for Mars, and a month is not long for it.

♐ SAGITTARIUS
Jupiter rules you and passes through Leo as a guest. From Virgo, Sun cuts across the appetite. Mutable fire: every option kept is an option paid for. It has stood four weeks; by now the cost is known.

♑ CAPRICORN
Saturn rules you, fallen in Aries. From Virgo, Sun concedes the point early. Earth moves first here, and first is enough. The same angle for four weeks, and the price has stopped moving.

♒ AQUARIUS
Saturn, your ruler, falls in Aries. From Scorpio, Venus sets a figure against the wanting. Air that holds on, charged for holding. The opposition to Venus that held two weeks ago has let go.

♓ PISCES
Jupiter, your ruler, moves through Leo unannounced. From Virgo, Sun quotes your worth back at you. Water bends, and each bend is invoiced. Three weeks ago Jupiter was still held by Venus; that is finished.
